label: Tutorial: full tour
description: The pages of the full tour, in order. A page: page (endpoint; its own tour gives the section steps, button-level ones left out) or sample (rule / bundle: a real public one, else the demo page) or url, title, overview (first step: the whole page), roles, when (empty: only on an instance with no rule), sections (false: not the page's own steps), steps (extra steps).

value.title: Welcome
value.overview: Rulezet is a library of detection rules — YARA, Sigma, Suricata, Zeek and more — to share, review, test and deploy. This instance has no rule yet: this page shows how to fill it.

steps.title: Get rules in minutes: connectors
steps.text: A **connector** links this instance to another Rulezet (rulezet.org for instance) and pulls its rules and bundles, with their tags, CVEs and ATT&CK techniques. **Soft** pull adds what is missing; **hard** pull also updates what you already have. Rules are matched by their UUID, so pulling again never creates duplicates.

steps.title: Or import Git repositories
steps.text: Any public repository of rules — SigmaHQ, Yara-Rules, Emerging Threats… — can be imported and kept up to date.

steps.title: Or write your own
steps.text: By hand, pasted, zipped or with the YARA editor.

steps.title: Your first rule and bundle
steps.text: So that this tour has something to show, Rulezet created a **first rule** and a **bundle** holding it, owned by you. Keep them, edit them or delete them whenever you want.

steps.title: Log in to start
steps.text: Everything starts with an account: log in (the first administrator received a generated password at install time — you will be asked to change it). The tour starts again once you are in.

value.title: Connectors
value.overview: Administrators link this instance to other Rulezet instances here — the quickest way to get rules.

value.title: Home
value.overview: The home page: search, the formats, what this instance holds and the latest activity.

value.title: Rules
value.overview: Every rule of the instance, with a search, a filter box and one card per rule.

value.title: A rule
value.overview: One rule and everything about it: its content, classification, actions, quality and discussion.

value.title: Add rules
value.overview: Every way to bring rules in: by hand, pasted, from Git, a zip, JSON or the YARA editor.

value.title: Bundles
value.overview: Bundles group rules of any format around one subject: a threat, a CVE, a project.

value.title: A bundle
value.overview: One bundle: what it is for, its actions, and tabs for its rules, structure, coverage and history.

value.title: Create a bundle
value.overview: Start a bundle: a name, a description and who can see it — rules are added right after.

value.title: CVE kits
value.overview: One page per vulnerability, gathering every rule that detects it.

value.title: ATT&CK
value.overview: MITRE ATT&CK, coloured by how many rules detect each technique.

value.title: Formats
value.overview: Every rule format Rulezet understands, and what each one is for.

value.title: Dashboard
value.overview: Your own page of widgets: charts, lists and counters you choose and arrange.

value.title: Notifications
value.overview: Everything that happened around you: comments, votes, proposals, alerts, finished jobs.

value.title: Your account
value.overview: Your profile, the people you follow, your comments and your API key.

value.title: Administration
value.overview: Instance settings. The Admin menu above leads to every administration page.

steps.title: The Admin menu
steps.text: Users and roles, configuration, imports and Git sources, background jobs, connectors, logs and moderation — only administrators see it.

steps.title: Reword this tutorial
steps.text: Every text of this tutorial is a setting: **Admin → Configuration**, category **Tutorial**.

steps.title: You have seen the essentials
steps.text:
On every page, the **Tutorial** icon (graduation cap, next to the settings gear) explains what is there, button by button.

Happy hunting!
